title: The give
description: What the same money does when you hand it over yourself. These items are rungs of the ladder in section five: they join the group in ladder.json that sets includesCharity, and are priced in alongside its rungs. Cheapest first is not required; the site sorts. Because they render as ladder rungs, singular and plural follow the ladder's rules: capitalized, one indivisible thing, and readable aloud after a number.

price.description: Dollars for one of them. A cost-per-life figure is an estimate with a wide band. Say so in the note.

note.description: Shown under the label. Supports the {price} token.

source.description: Required here, not optional. A number about saving a life must name who worked it out.
